title: Mass Invitation to Prayer
text:
PRIEST: Pray, brothers and Sisters,
that my sacrifice and yours
may be acceptable to God,
the almighty Father.

PEOPLE: May the Lord accept the sacrifice at your hands
for the praise and glory of his name,
for our good
and the good of all his holy Church.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
